text:
Maya Ramaswamy: Quick sync — planning a small milestone cutover for Console Observability this week. Goals: enable 90d trace retention for key dashboards, land tracing hooks for payments and routing, and roll a canary for new error-analysis view. Need owners and blockers.

Tom H.: I can own the payments tracing hook integration. Need to confirm schema with eng-runtime (cc @Devin).

Devin Patel: Thanks — I just checked the runtime change list. We have a new header field `x-rw-trace-id` in staging. Devs need to add it to the agent shim. I'll open a PR today.

Jessie Nguyen: For dashboards: which panels are considered "key"? I can prioritize tiles if we list them. Also will the new retention affect cost alerts? :thinking_face:

Maya Ramaswamy: Key panels = Payments latency p50/p95, Payment error types, Checkout trace waterfall. Also the new Error Analysis view (grouping by stack frame) — that one should be canaried to 5% first. Cost alerts: Rahul, can you confirm threshold changes for 90d?

Rahul Singh: Looking now. If we flip from 30d -> 90d we estimate ~2.8x index storage increase for traces. We'll need to bump the storage budget or enable sampling. Two options: (1) keep 90d for payments only, enable 10% sampling elsewhere; (2) full 90d with higher budget. Recommend option 1 for rollout.

Maya Ramaswamy: Option 1 sounds safe. Tom, can you scope payments-only retention change? Jessie please prepare dashboard flags for canary.

Tom H.: Scoped — payments-only retention toggle is a config flag: `console.tracing.retention.payments_days=90`. Will add toggle to the feature flags service. PR will include migration script to tag payments traces.

Devin Patel: PR draft: https://git.internal/rw/runtime/pulls/842 (WIP). Includes header parsing and KV mapping. Need eng-platform review for feature-flag gating.

Jessie Nguyen: I'll add the flags to the dashboard config and wire a canary rule: percent_rollout=5, start_time=sometime-Friday. Putting a stub PR: https://git.internal/rw/console/pulls/599

Maya Ramaswamy: Can someone call out cross-team deps? I have: runtime (Devin), console config + UI (Jessie), storage/billing (Rahul), infra rollout + canary (sre). Any other?

sre-bot: deploy-bot: canary plan requires staging smoke tests + 1h canary. See playbook: https://internal/playbooks/observability-canary.

Rahul Singh: Also need to coordinate with eng-storage for index shard allocation. I'll ping them and add a short runbook entry.

Tom H.: I'll include a migration checklist in the PR body and tag eng-storage.

Devin Patel: One quick ask: unit tests for header loss cases — if the header is missing we must fall back to old trace grouping. I'll add tests.

Jessie Nguyen: QA plan: (1) staging smoke, (2) 5% canary for 3 hours, (3) extend to 25% if no alerts, (4) full rollout. Add post-deploy validation: ensure Payments p95 is within 10% of baseline.

Maya Ramaswamy: Timeline proposal: PRs open by EOD tomorrow, reviews Friday, staging deploy Saturday morning, canary Saturday afternoon. Sound realistic?

Rahul Singh: Tight but doable if reviews are quick. I'll pre-approve storage changes conditionally.

Devin Patel: I'll try to get runtime PR ready tonight. Requesting eng-platform review tag `@eng-platform` on the PR when ready.

Tom H.: Will ping for review once PRs are green.

Jessie Nguyen: I'll add dashboard smoke test scripts and a short checklist in the PR description.

Maya Ramaswamy: Action items:
- Tom: feature flag + migration PR (payments retention)
- Devin: runtime header + tests PR
- Jessie: dashboard flags + canary rules + QA scripts
- Rahul: storage budget + eng-storage coordination
- SRE: staging canary runbook + smoke tests

Maya Ramaswamy: If nobody objects, I'll lock timeline and post final plan in #eng-platform by EOD. :thumbsup:

Tom H.: :thumbsup:

Devin Patel: :rocket:

Jessie Nguyen: :ok_hand:

Rahul Singh: +1

sre-bot: note: scheduled maintenance window Sat 02:00-05:00 UTC.

Maya Ramaswamy: Good catch. We'll avoid the maintenance window for the canary. Moving canary to Saturday 08:00 UTC. Last call for objections.

Tom H.: no objections from payments side.

Devin Patel: no objections.

Jessie Nguyen: good to go from UI side.

Rahul Singh: all set. I'll update the cost alert thresholds and post the storage note.

Maya Ramaswamy: Thanks all — I'll post the plan and PR links shortly and tag reviewers.

Tom H.: FYI I've added the migration checklist to the PR body: `- backup indices - run tagger - enable flag`

Devin Patel: ping me for an in-person review if you want to walk through the header mapping.

Maya Ramaswamy: End of thread — will follow up in the plan doc.
